own_solution.law: Torricelli outflow v = sqrt(2 g h) with continuity A dh/dt = -a sqrt(2 g h) => t = (A/a) * 2 (sqrt(h1) - sqrt(h2)) / sqrt(2 g)
assumptions: surface speed negligible, jet area = hole area (stated)

defect_reasons.other: A measured water density of 962 kg/m^3 is unusual (it corresponds to water near 90 C) and slightly artificial, though not contradictory since no water density or temperature is stated.

notes: A/a = (400/10)^2 = 1600; 2(sqrt0.8 - sqrt0.2) = 0.894427; /sqrt(19.6) = 0.894427/4.427189 = 0.2020305; t = 323.25 s. Hole widened to 11.3 mm: A/a = (400/11.3)^2 = 1253.03; t = 253.15 s. Density cancels from Bernoulli (rho g h = rho v^2/2). Barrel-hole and after-timing sentences are D. Numbers agree within pairs (1.3 mm, 962 kg/m^3).
